scope: prelaunch cache semantics and source-restoration evidence; not forward execution evidence
timestamp_convention: current cached AV15/30 inputs use interval-start labels; verified empirically, not a universal vendor timestamp guarantee
nested_close_check: AV30 close at start t equals AV15 close at t+15min; production normalization repeats this check for every selected fallback subbar
raw_restoration: intraday adjusted close times same-provider daily raw close divided by daily adjusted close; no second split adjustment
limitation: historical adjustment restoration is retrospective. Original cache retrieval time is not independently known; local observation is recorded at package assembly. Future fallback caches must preserve and pass the same source-specific nested checks.
